description: Listings of one LabX seller (lab equipment marketplace) from the seller's public profile page: listing id, title, price range, currency, condition, category, source link and availability date (about 20 per page), plus the seller's active-listing count. Prices are the seller's asking prices as listed; 'Request a Quote' listings have no price. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

seller.description: LabX seller path: slug/id as in the profile URL, e.g. union-standard-equipment/51621
